We are happy to announce that the Early Access version of our new game, [b]Minigolf Galaxy, is now available![/b] Create your very own cosmic minigolf courses, engage in fun challenges, and embark on a stellar journey through the universe.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2303080?utm_source=steamnews

notes.title: Dread Nautical Sails to Steam on October 27!
notes.notes:
[h2]Dread Nautical, the creepiest tactical RPG you'll ever play arrives on Steam on October 27 - just in time for Halloween!

Please wishlist today![/h2]

[previewyoutube=K4r_kWqyfFY;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey CastleStormers! This is not CastleStorm strictly, but we thought you might be interested in our new release!

Get into the spirit as one of four unlikely survivors:

[b]Miraje[/b], a lounge singer who’s not going down with this ship
[b]Hatano[/b], a katana-wielding badass with a troubled past
[b]Vi[/b], a young gamer who will need to grow up fast
[b]Fargo[/b], a personal investigator who’s too old for this ****

A tactical turn-based RPG with roguelike elements, Dread Nautical combines immersive gameplay with a colorful, but deeply eldritch tone. Supernatural forces have overwhelmed a cruise liner called Hope whisking away the entire clientele and crew to a different dimension.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34070339/be35240b51cf7337404bac0f52d8f24c0a9bf88f.jpg[/img]

Manage your scarce resources effectively, and convince scattered survivors to fight alongside you. You’ll need them for any hope of escaping this “vacation” alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34070339/44e2a9eef15c83635d56e93f9a9783c08ba4fb2f.jpg[/img]

Traverse all 20 decks of the to unlock the mysteries of the Hope. Think several steps ahead during each battle, plotting the optimal use of each character’s action points. Your weapons, bandages, and other items deteriorate, and your resources are very limited. Make sure your companions rest, or panic may overtake them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34070339/42542773098734dbfc655e3721ee373c0287c737.gif[/img]

Be sure to keep up with us on our different channels for updates, jokes and more in-depth info:

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/KPJupxP

[previewyoutube=GqGC1wK-o_A;full][/previewyoutube]

Our modern homage to classic first-person dungeon-crawlers takes you to an unconventional fantasy world inspired by a faraway land referenced in countless Central European folktales. An old-school turn-based battle system combines with inspiration from unexplored mythology to offer an RPG experience that feels unique yet also familiar.

It is seriously fun and really scratches that itch Wizardry or Legend of Grimrock left that some of you might feel.

The game also arrives on Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4 and Gog.com March 31.

Thanks for reading!

Akos

notes.title: CastleStorm invades mobile with Android beta
notes.notes: Mountain trolls, stone golems, and fire breathing dragons are invading mobile devices. The hybrid tower defense title CastleStorm is coming to Android and iOS devices. CastleStorm: Free To Siege is a free-to-play mobile game. The four nations from the PC/console original will return with their own troop classes, weapons, and spells. Once the game is released, it will feature eight playable heroes. CastleStorm: Free To Siege will also contain new spells for its mobile versions of the game.

notes.title: Now Available - CastleStorm
notes.notes:
CastleStorm is Now Available on Steam


Welcome to the world of CastleStorm, a super genre mashup of 2D physics destruction mashed with tower defense brawler! CastleStorm was born out of the fond childhood memory of building and destroying LEGO castles.

The clouds bring rumors of war…It’s Knights vs. Vikings in CastleStorm, where medieval warfare meets 2D physics-based destruction! Controlling the battle in real time, players will harness the power of medieval artillery, manage a fearsome ground attack, and cast powerful spells! CastleStorm features a story-driven solo campaign, a custom castle editor, online multiplayer, co-op modes, and more. Building castles and knocking them down has never been so much fun!

CastleStorm is a physics based tower destruction game, combining elements of real time strategy, resource management, and a beautiful blend of challenging gameplay scenarios.
